messages:
Maya: Received a consolidated invoice from BeaconWare for $48,600. PDF has multiple sub-invoices but NO PO numbers on line items. Upload showed vendor code BWN-EXT. Anyone know quick way to match to existing POs? cc @Aria
AP-Bot: invoice 987654 uploaded to AP queue 'finance-reconcile' — HOLD: missing PO on line items. (auto-flag)
Aria: Which BeaconWare entity? We have BeaconWare Inc (US) and BeaconWare EU. If the vendor code is BWN-EXT that maps to the US vendor. Are there dept codes on the PDF?
Maya: There's a small table: `Dept: CORE / Dept: INFRA` but no cost center numbers. I'll paste the top lines:
```
INV#  Date       Description                      Amount
000-421 2026-03-18 Premium GPU time (CORE)         $29,400
000-422 2026-03-18 Support & telemetry (INFRA)     $19,200
```
Ethan: If it's split across CORE and INFRA we might map to two open PRs: PR-3121 (CORE infra hours) and PR-2950 (infra monitoring). Neither PR has a PO attached though — looks like Purch is missing on those PRs.
Aria: Paging @Ethan-Purchasing — can you check PR-3121 and PR-2950 and either attach existing PO or create a short-term PO for this vendor? Otherwise AP will keep the invoice on hold.
Ethan: On it. Quick question — vendor billed consolidated rather than separate invoices per entity. I can create two internal POs and ask AP to split the invoice, but vendor will need a bill-to change. I'll reach out to BeaconWare support.
Vendor Support (BeaconWare): Hi Maya — we can reissue split invoices per legal entity within 24 hours. Do you want that? Also we can add PO numbers if you provide them.
Maya: Yes please reissue split invoices and add PO numbers on each. Aria/Ethan — once PRs/POs are created I'll route back to AP for match. I'll set the invoice to manual approval to avoid auto-reject.
AP-Bot: invoice 987654 status updated: manual-routing to Aria for approver override by Maya.
Aria: Thanks, assigning manual approver and flagging GL code mapping. ETA to confirm mapping: tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll update the AP ticket and ping vendor when PO numbers exist. :thumbsup:
